items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I've only known Pee Wee since 1926.

ctx.x: He had a name he called him. He called Pee Wee Marquette something, because Pee Wee Marquette for the record's sake is like - what would you call that? Is he a midget or would you call that a dwarf?
He's a cross between a dwarf and a midget. I've only known Pee Wee since 1926.
He's really not a midget but in my sight, he's black.
